# International typography fixtures

These are test-only subsets generated with FontTools from upstream Noto fonts:

- `NotoSansCJKsc-Subset.ttf` from Noto Sans SC Variable;
- `NotoSansArabic-Subset.ttf` from Noto Sans Arabic Variable; and
- `NotoEmoji-Subset.ttf` from Noto Emoji Variable.

Only the representative characters used by `international-text.test.ts` are
retained. The files are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 in
`OFL.txt`, are not included in the npm package, and must not be used as general
application fonts because their glyph coverage is intentionally tiny.
